_comment: Copy to deployment.json (gitignored) and fill in. Every script reads this one file.

source.description: Namespace for the one content repository in this deployment. Lowercase, no slashes.

_gatewayAuth: "oidc": sign-in with any OIDC provider, needs identity.* below. "iam": AWS IAM (SigV4) sign-in, identity.* not needed. See docs/identity.md.
_runtimeArtifact: "image": MCP server as a container, needs Docker to deploy. "code": as a zip (AgentCore direct code deployment), no Docker.

identity._provider: "entra", "cognito" or "oidc" (generic: discoveryUrl, allowedAudiences, allowedScopes, allowedClients, clientClaim, requiredClaims). The gate is the audience and/or scope of this server; allowedClients is optional (empty = any MCP client). Fill only the section named here.
